tool_notes.generate_image: Give items [{id, cut_id, prompt}], up to 3 at a time: id = gn-<cut_id>-1, prompt = one concrete English sentence about what to draw (subject, setting, light); the tool adds the style. It returns per item {id, cut_id, file, reused, cost_usd} or {id, error}. At most one new image per cut and 80 new images per run; the same prompt reuses the stored file at no cost. On an error such as "MODEL_API_KEY is not set" or a quota error, stop generating and save what you have.
tool_notes.preview_materials: Before uploading, look at the generated pictures as they will look on screen: items [{id, file}], up to 6 at a time. Check for garbled text or letters, wrong subjects, or a fake-evidence look (fake documents, fake people presented as real). Every material you save must have been looked at.
tool_notes.generated_upload: Upload the pictures, once each (a picture used in several cuts is uploaded once), up to 10 at a time: file = the file generate_image returned, title = material id, description = why_fit, source = "muse-image-1.0 generated".
tool_notes.save_output: Call it once at the end, after previewing and uploading the pictures with generated_upload. List every content cut once, in scene order, each with its one picture, as the form says.

part_id.description: the part id of this scene; copy it from the input as is (p1, p2, ...)

cut_id.description: a content cut of this scene (every visuals cut that is not the title or end card); copy the input's cut id as is (c01, c02, ...)

material.description: the one generated picture of this cut (never empty). A picture that fits several cuts is made once and put in each of them.

id.description: gn-<cut_id>-1 (e.g. gn-c03-1), with the cut_id of the first cut this material is listed in. The same material listed in later cuts keeps this id and is copied identically.

why_fit.description: one short sentence on why it fits the cut; the conclusion only, no template or field names; English only

file.description: the file generate_image returned, as is

prompt.description: the English prompt the picture was generated from

cuts.description: one entry per content cut, every content cut once, in scene order, no other cuts
